items.title: Families bear hidden costs of finding safety
items.summary: Led by La Trobe University, the research sheds light on a largely overlooked question in response to family violence: What does it cost families to become safe?

items.title: Young golden eagles leave their parents' territory late
items.summary: When a young golden eagle (Aquila chrysaetos) finally leaves its parents' territory, it leaves behind the only safety net it has ever known. Until now, biologists had assumed that eagles took this step as soon as they could fly well enough to survive on their own.

items.title: Football Daily | Two goals, some polish and a rebrand: City flip Sávio for quite the profit
items.summary: Sign up now! Sign up now! Sign up now? Sign up now! We see Manchester City have managed to flip Savinho for quite the profit . Football Daily had previously assumed this sort of wheeler-dealing was restricted to the Dion-Dublin-adjacent property market, or the Harry-Redknapp-infused used car scene, but it seems we were mistaken. We have no idea how City ended up trousering a £44.2m markup on a player who cost £30.8m two seasons ago, and has achieved the square root of eff all since, but they’ve done it.
